name: AFWC
description: Advanced Frame Window Counter: high-accuracy frame analysis (re-simulates your run to measure the exact frame window of every click) and a live frame window counter (markers and HUD counters).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for the frame window counter and for recording.

auto-record.name: Record every attempt
auto-record.description: Keeps the inputs of the current attempt so that it can be saved, analysed and scanned.

auto-save-complete.name: Save completed runs
auto-save-complete.description: When you beat a level, the recorded run becomes the active run and is stored on disk.

record-tps.name: Recording TPS
record-tps.description: Ticks per second of recorded runs. 240 is the vanilla physics rate; change it only if you use a TPS bypass.

show-hud.name: Counter HUD
show-hud.description: Per-label counters in the top-left corner.

show-markers.name: Click markers
show-markers.description: A ring with the frame window appears on the player at every click.

marker-seconds.name: Marker lifetime (s)
marker-seconds.description: How long a marker stays on screen.

marker-detail.name: Early/late detail
marker-detail.description: Show how many ticks early/late a click could have been, e.g. 3 (-1/+1).

show-info-line.name: Info line
show-info-line.description: Bottom line with the window, required input rate and position in the run.

scan-max-shift.name: Search radius (ticks)
scan-max-shift.description: How far each click is moved in each direction. Windows larger than this are reported as lower bounds.

scan-horizon.name: Survive after next click (ticks)
scan-horizon.description: A shifted click only counts if the player survives until the next click plus this many ticks. -1 = until the end of the run.

scan-shift-mode.name: Shift mode
scan-shift-mode.description: whole-tap moves press and release together (keeps the hold length). press-only moves just the press.

scan-verify.name: Verify determinism
scan-verify.description: Compare the re-simulation with the original run on every tick. Leave on for exact results.

scan-budget-ms.name: Time per frame (ms)
scan-budget-ms.description: How much of each rendered frame the scanner may use. Higher = faster scan, lower frame rate.
